class_id: a retry loop keeps only its latest failure cause
feature: any retry loop whose per-attempt outcome is written to a single overwritten column or a one-row-per-step ledger: here documents.extraction_error and ipo_pipeline_steps (unique on ipo_id, step_id) for every document type the extractor or anchor reader retries, on every slot
symptom: The retry COUNT survives and the diagnosis does not: each attempt overwrites the previous cause, so a document at the retry ceiling cannot answer 'the same fault N times, or N different faults?', which is exactly the decision the count exists to inform. A module comment described the overwritten ledger as an attempt audit trail. A sibling shape was found in the same writer: the declared value set of the status column (a Postgres enum), its comment and the values actually written were three different sets, with nothing enforcing any of them.
first_seen: #634 (2026-09-17): ESDS Software Solution Limited RHP at MANUAL_REVIEW, retry_count 10, extraction_error 'blocked_after_10_attempts@extract_filing.py@2026-09-03'; all ten E1-E10 ledger rows held the identical terminal string. Measured again on ipodhan_staging 2026-09-26: 43 MANUAL_REVIEW + 7 FAILED documents, max retry_count 10 (ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT 39, PRICE_BAND_AD 3, RHP 1 at MANUAL_REVIEW), each holding one cause. #676 / F-183: declared enum PENDING|IN_PROGRESS|SUCCESS|PARTIAL|FAILED (used only by extraction_logs.status), comment PENDING|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED|FAILED|MANUAL_REVIEW, written COMPLETED 158 / PENDING 90 / NOT_EXTRACTABLE 77 / MANUAL_REVIEW 43 / FAILED 7.
fix_prs: fix/676-634-extraction-status-and-attempt-causes: migration 0065 adds document_extraction_attempts (append-only, one row per FAILED/MANUAL_REVIEW write with attempt number, cause and time, written in the same transaction as the status by writeStatusWithAttempt) and ck_documents_extraction_status NOT VALID generated from DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION_STATUSES; the column is typed $type<DocumentExtractionStatus>() so an undeclared literal does not compile. No backfill: causes before 0065 were never recorded.
detection_check: d_extraction_status_declared (nightly floor) for the value set; scraper/tests/integration/document-extraction-attempts.integration.test.ts (three failures keep three causes in order; red when the insert is removed) for the attempt history. No nightly check yet asserts that a FAILED/MANUAL_REVIEW document has at least one attempt row, because every document failed before 0065 legitimately has none.
